title: Assessing sequence reversal effects on coiled-coil stability using AI-based structure prediction and enhanced sampling atomistic simulations.
authors: Arnittali, Maria; Markopoulou, Elena; Harmandaris, Vagelis; Rissanou, Anastassia N
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合AI结构预测与增强采样分子动力学模拟，系统评估序列反转对卷曲螺旋蛋白wtRop结构稳定性与自由能景观的影响，是蛋白质结构计算与AI/物理模拟方法深度融合的典型工作。
abstract: This study investigates the impact of sequence inversion on the structural integrity and thermodynamic stability of the wtRop protein, a prototypical coiled-coil motif. We utilized AI-driven structure prediction (ColabFold) to generate initial models for the unknown rRop sequence, which yielded both parallel and antiparallel monomeric orientations. These models were subjected to classical molecular dynamics simulations and well-tempered metadynamics. The combination of atomistic simulations and enhanced sampling techniques allowed for the calculation of the free energy surface across four collective variables: (i) angle between the monomers, (ii) distance between the monomer's center of mass, (iii) helicity and (iv) torsion angle similarity, characterizing the energetic barriers and conformational transitions of the parallel rRop, the antiparallel rRop, and the parent wtRop systems. Free energy analysis reveals that both rRop models deviate from the native antiparallel orientation to stabilize at an intermediate angle. Notably, the antiparallel variant exhibits the most significant instability, characterized by increased monomer separation and a more pronounced loss of secondary structure relative to the wild-type and the parallel model. While both reversed sequences show a reduction in alpha-helicity compared to wtRop, the antiparallel model demonstrates a more pronounced loss of structural integrity, characterized by a disrupted hydrogen bond network, increased solvent-accessible surface area, and the failure to maintain a robust hydrophobic core. Free energy calculations further confirmed that the parallel variant shares greater conformational similarity with the parent protein.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了序列倒置对wtRop蛋白（一种典型的卷曲螺旋基序）结构完整性和热力学稳定性的影响。我们利用AI驱动的结构预测（ColabFold）为未知的rRop序列生成初始模型，这些模型产生了平行和反平行的单体取向。这些模型随后进行了经典分子动力学模拟和well-tempered metadynamics模拟。原子级模拟与增强采样技术的结合使我们能够计算四个集体变量下的自由能面：（i）单体之间的角度，（ii）单体质心之间的距离，（iii）螺旋度，以及（iv）扭转角相似性，从而表征平行rRop、反平行rRop和亲本wtRop系统的能垒及构象转变。自由能分析揭示，两种rRop模型均偏离天然的反平行取向，稳定在中间角度。值得注意的是，反平行变体表现出最显著的不稳定性，其特征为单体分离增加和相对于野生型及平行模型更明显的二级结构丧失。尽管两种反向序列相比wtRop均显示α-螺旋度降低，但反平行模型表现出更明显的结构完整性丧失，其特征为氢键网络破坏、溶剂可及表面积增加，以及未能维持稳健的疏水核心。自由能计算进一步证实，平行变体与亲本蛋白在构象上具有更大的相似性。
